text.p: Tropical Cyclone 06P, with 50 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea north of New Caledonia. This system is strengthening and is moving south at 10 mph. It is expected to reach New Caledonia in about 36 hours with top winds of 60-70 mph. It will likely produce local flooding and wind damage in New Caledonia. This system will also be a threat to any shipping in the region.

Tropical Cyclone 07S, with 40 mph winds, is in the Southern Indian Ocean near 7.3s/89.2e, tracking west southwest at 20 mph. Tropical Cyclone 07S is expected to steadily intensify while moving west southwestward to southwestward during the next 48 hours. By then, top winds should be near 75 mph. This system will be a threat only to shipping.

Tropical Depression Marco is currently centered about 160 miles south of Kingston, Jamaica, moving west at 7 mph. This motion is expected to continue while Marco weakens through tonight. Marco is a moderate threat to boating and shipping in the region at this time.
